text:
user: Cutting drop-off at the payment step. Conversion dipped after our last release.
assistant: Start by splitting the funnel by payment method. The dip is often in just one of them.

user: Jun Hao asked me to look at his CV. He wants to move from Lazada logistics into a data analyst role.
assistant: Happy to help. Paste it in and tell me which roles he's targeting.

user: Mostly analyst roles at banks. He's got SQL but no Python yet.
assistant: Then lead with his SQL projects and add a short Python course to the CV.

user: Ok thanks. Unrelated, I play futsal every Wednesday night at Kallang and my calves keep cramping. Tips?
assistant: Hydrate through the day, stretch before the game and take some electrolytes beforehand.

user: Our mid-year sale is three weeks out, so my team is in war-room mode.
assistant: Take care of yourself. Batch-cook a few easy dinners so you're not living on takeaway.
